name: Algebraic Matroid Framing
description: Translates the graph connectivity problem into an equivalent linear algebra problem over a graphic matroid. Finding a minimum-cost subset of edges to connect a set of terminals is exactly finding a minimum-cost subset of difference vectors $e_u - e_v$ whose linear span contains all target difference vectors $e_a - e_b$. This completely removes all graph and path-finding affordances, forcing the model to mathematically deduce the equivalence to Steiner Tree rather than pattern-matching.
